_note: 门户「知识图谱」的数据源。与 chapters.json 的分工：chapters.json 描述「怎么学」（目标、前置、时长、导览），本文件描述「学了什么」—— 每个知识点的一句话总结、标签、所属小节，以及知识点之间的关系。节点 id 统一写成「章号.n序」，构建时与 chapters.json 的 concept.nodes 逐条核对，任何一方改了另一方没跟上都会直接构建失败，避免图和正文悄悄脱节。

summary.zh: 全部 5 个主题簇、26 个知识点。点开任意一章，看它由哪些点组成；点开任意一点，看它在课程里的位置。
summary.en: Five topic clusters and 26 concepts. Open a chapter to see what it is made of; open a concept to see where it sits in the course.

summary.zh: 把「数据是什么」拆成四件可操作的事：怎么装载、怎么定义、怎么分类、怎么变换。这一章决定后面每一张图的地基。
summary.en: Turns 'what is data' into four actionable tasks — load, define, classify, transform — and lays the foundation for every chart that follows.

summary.zh: Card 的三段式模型把可视化拆成一条流水线：变换、映射、渲染，再加一圈交互反馈。整门课的主干骨架。
summary.en: Card's three stages split visualization into a pipeline — transform, map, render — plus a feedback loop. The backbone of the whole course.

summary.zh: 颜色是唯一一个「用错了没人提醒、但读者会直接读错」的通道，所以从流程里拆出来单列一章，八节讲透。
summary.en: Colour is the one channel that fails silently while readers misread the chart — hence a standalone chapter of eight sections.

summary.zh: 低维数据的四类基本操作：整理成可画的形状、换坐标系、拟合出趋势、按人的感知摆放。全是可以直接抄的写法。
summary.en: Four basic moves for low-dimensional data: reshape, rescale, fit a trend, and place marks where perception expects them.

summary.zh: 时间有五种属性，每一种都有比折线图更合适的画法。这一章按属性选图，而不是按数据长什么样选图。
summary.en: Time has five properties and each has an answer better than the line chart. Choose the chart by property, not by data shape.

summary.zh: 从 DeepSeek 合成的 2024 级新生数据出发，用 d3.csv 的 row 回调一次完成字段映射与类型转换。
summary.en: Start from DeepSeek-synthesized freshman data; d3.csv's row callback does field mapping and type conversion in one pass.

summary.zh: 数据→信息→知识→智慧的四级金字塔。可视化主要停在「信息」这一级，再往上走要格外谨慎。
summary.en: The four-level pyramid from data to wisdom. Visualization mostly stops at 'information'; claims above it need care.

01.n3.zh: 数据属性 · 尺度 × 通道

summary.zh: Stevens 的四种测量尺度决定哪些运算合法，Mackinlay 的通道排名决定属性该映射到位置、长度还是颜色。
summary.en: Stevens' four scales decide which operations are legal; Mackinlay's channel ranking decides position, length or colour.

01.n4.zh: 数据变换 · 函数式数组

summary.zh: filter / map / rollup 把原始数组变成能画的表。变换写在数据一侧，绘图代码就只剩「画」。
summary.en: filter / map / rollup turn raw arrays into a plottable table; keep the transform on the data side and the chart code stays pure.

summary.zh: enter / update / exit 解释数据变化时 DOM 发生了什么；key 函数是过渡动画能不能对上的前提。
summary.en: enter / update / exit explain what happens to the DOM when data changes; the key function is what makes a transition coherent.

summary.zh: Card 把可视化拆成三段：数据变换、视觉映射、视图渲染。后面四节就是逐段拆开讲这三段。
summary.en: Card splits visualization into three stages: transform, visual mapping, view rendering. The next sections take them one by one.

summary.zh: 双层 rollup 把明细行压成图表要的维度表，正则清洗负责把「计算机科学与技术」这类脏字段拆开。
summary.en: Two-level rollup collapses detail rows into the table a chart needs; regex cleaning splits dirty fields apart.

summary.zh: Reingold-Tilford 树布局加通道理论：把表的列映射成位置、长度、颜色，同时保证不丢信息。
summary.en: Reingold–Tilford layout plus channel theory: map table columns onto position, length and colour without losing information.

summary.zh: 数据绑定落到 SVG 元素上成为最终画面，比例尺、坐标轴、过渡动画都发生在这一步。
summary.en: Data joins land on SVG elements to produce the picture; scales, axes and transitions all happen here.

summary.zh: 交互把「看到的图」变回「可操作的数据」，于是 Card 的三段式变成一个闭环，而不是一条直路。
summary.en: Interaction turns the seen chart back into operable data, closing Card's three stages into a loop instead of a straight line.

summary.zh: RGB 面向屏幕、HSL 面向直觉，Lab 与 HCL 才是感知均匀的——这是能把数字映射成颜色的前提。
summary.en: RGB for screens, HSL for intuition, Lab/HCL for perceptual uniformity — the precondition for mapping numbers to colour.

summary.zh: 顺序型、发散型、定性型对应三种数据语义。用错会让读者凭空读出一个不存在的中点或边界。
summary.en: Sequential, diverging and qualitative match three data semantics; the wrong pick invents a midpoint or a boundary.

summary.zh: 单色、类比、互补、三等分、分裂互补——从色轮关系推出一组协调而非随手拼的颜色。
summary.en: Monochromatic, analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complementary: harmony derived from the wheel, not from taste.

summary.zh: Wong、Paul Tol、Okabe-Ito 三套经过色觉缺陷检验的色板。做论文图不用自己凑颜色。
summary.en: Wong, Paul Tol and Okabe-Ito are CVD-tested palettes — reuse them instead of inventing colours for a paper figure.

summary.zh: 类别数控制在 7 以内，靠色相拉开区分、靠降低饱和度压住刺眼感，既醒目又耐看。
summary.en: Keep categories under seven, separate by hue, calm by lowering saturation: noticeable yet comfortable.

summary.zh: 用红绿色盲模拟检查图还能不能读。结论只有一条：颜色永远不能是唯一的编码通道。
summary.en: Simulate red-green deficiency to check the figure still reads. The rule: hue must never be the only encoding channel.

04.n1.zh: 数据转换 宽 → 长

summary.zh: 宽表转长表是分组绘图的第一步：一条记录一个观测，图才知道该按哪一列分组。
summary.en: Wide-to-long reshaping is step one for grouped charts: one observation per row tells the chart what to group by.

summary.zh: 线性、对数、序数比例尺决定数值怎么变成像素；坐标轴、网格、刻度要分层画，改主题才不用重写。
summary.en: Linear, log and ordinal scales decide how numbers become pixels; axis, grid and ticks are drawn in layers.

summary.zh: d3-regression 的十种模型，用 R² 判断该信任哪条线——以及 R² 高不等于模型对。
summary.en: Ten models in d3-regression; use R² to decide which line to trust — and remember a high R² is not proof.

summary.zh: 人对角度的分辨在 45° 附近最灵敏，斜率图要刻意把主要对比压在这个黄金角附近。
summary.en: Angle discrimination peaks around 45°, so slope charts should push the main contrast near that golden angle.

summary.zh: 从标量场网格里提取等值线的经典算法，逐格判断 16 种情形。d3-contour 内置了它。
summary.en: The classic algorithm for pulling isolines out of a scalar grid, sixteen cases per cell. d3-contour ships it.

summary.zh: 时间点、时间间隔、持续时间、时序、节律。先分清属性语义，再决定画什么图。
summary.en: Instant, interval, duration, sequence and rhythm: name the semantics first, then choose the chart.

05.n2.zh: 标准时间可视化 折线图

summary.zh: 折线图是时间序列的默认答案，也是衡量其他时间图表值不值得用的参照基线。
summary.en: The line chart is the default answer for time series and the baseline every other temporal chart must beat.

summary.zh: van Wijk 的日历视图把长期数据压进一屏，按月分隔线保留「月」这个最重要的节律。
summary.en: Van Wijk's calendar view compresses long series into one screen while month dividers preserve the monthly rhythm.

05.n4.zh: 周期时间 阿基米德螺旋

summary.zh: 螺旋把周期数据卷成一圈一圈，同一相位落在同一角度上，趋势和季节能同时看见。
summary.en: A spiral coils periodic data so equal phases share an angle — trend and season become visible at once.

summary.zh: 用横向轨道表达事件与状态变化，适合讲「谁在什么时候做了什么」，而不适合讲精确数值。
summary.en: Horizontal tracks express events and state changes — good for who did what when, poor for exact values.
